Symbol (any unicode, or U+XXXX; empty disables)
Tap a symbol, or an empty tile, to change it. Underlined symbols start a compose sequence. The amber arrows are shift and caps lock. Faint keys are fixed.
The symbols around the keys in number mode. Ones you haven\'t changed here start from the default symbols. Faint keys are fixed.
The function column. The settings key and the empty tiles can be changed; the other function keys are fixed. A settings key must remain somewhere in letter mode.

There must be a settings key in letter mode (the Letters tab or the function column), or you could not get back to this editor. Put \"Opens the settings\" on one of its keys, or reset the settings key to its default.
